title: Wind
description: Schema for wind speed and direction sensor data

eventTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the measurement was taken

traceId.description: Unique identifier for tracing this message

messageNumber.description: Sequence number, increased by one for each new message

sensorId.description: Unique identifier for the sensor. Typically the serial number (S/N) from the sensor.

speed.description: Wind speed in meters per second (m/s)

direction.description: Wind direction in degrees from true north (0-359°)
